description: This file defines the ACLRole class, which manages roles within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for role management, such as retrieving roles associated with users, setting role actions, and converting roles to/from array representations.

classes.name: ACLRole
classes.description: Represents a user role in the SuiteCRM system, managing permissions, associated actions, and relationships with users.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the name of the role as a string.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the access level for a specific role-action relationship.

methods.name: getUserRoles
methods.description: Returns a list of role names or objects for a specific user.

methods.name: getUserRoleNames
methods.description: Returns a list of role names for a specific user, utilizing cache for performance.

methods.name: getAllRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all roles, optionally returning them as arrays.

methods.name: getRoleActions
methods.description: Fetches actions associated with a given role, categorized by module.

methods.name: mark_relationships_deleted
methods.description: Marks all relationships between a role and its actions as deleted.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the role object to an array with selected fields.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Populates the role object from an associative array.
